chunks: And Isma'il ibn Muslim narrated from him that he said:
"If a boy is able to fast for three consecutive days, then fasting the month of Ramadan has become obligatory upon him."

key_terms.أَطَاقَ: was able; had the capacity to endure

ai.seo_question: When does fasting the month of Ramadan become obligatory for a boy according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal indicator for when a boy becomes responsible for the fast of Ramadan. It links obligation to the child's capacity to endure fasting for three consecutive days, reflecting a practical measure of readiness for this act of worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1904 - It is narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) through Isma'il ibn Muslim that He said:
"If a boy is able to fast for three consecutive days, fasting the Month of Ramadan becomes obligatory upon him."
